title.zh: 第十二 天文下 桓三十八 靈二十 獻九 隕石
title.raw: 第十二 天文下 桓三十八 靈二十 獻九 隕石 Volume 102: Astronomy Part Three

sentences.zh: 志第十二 天文下

translations.literal: Treatise twelve: Astronomy, part two.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 12: Astronomy, lower fascicle.

sentences.zh: 桓三十八 灵二十 献九 陨石

translations.literal: Huan thirty-eight, Ling twenty, Xian nine, meteorite.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-eight portents under Emperor Huan, twenty under Ling, nine under Emperor Xian, and meteorite records.

sentences.zh: 桓三十八

translations.literal: Huan: thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huan the Filial and Mighty: thirty-eight entries.

sentences.zh: 孝桓建和元年八月壬寅，荧惑犯舆鬼质星。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianhe of Emperor Huan the Filial and Mighty, in the eighth month, on the day renyin, Mars offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eighth month of Jianhe 1, Mars crossed the attendant star of the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 二年二月辛卯，荧惑行在舆鬼中。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the second month, on the day xinmao, Mars traveled among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the second month of Jianhe 2, Mars lingered inside the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 三年五月己丑，太白行入太微右掖门，留十五日，出端门。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the fifth month, on the day jichou, Great White traveled into the right side gate of the Grand Tenuity, lingered fifteen days, then emerged from the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the fifth month of Jianhe 3, Venus entered the right inner gate of the Grand Tenuity, halted fifteen days, then exited the Duan Gate.

sentences.zh: 丙申，荧惑入东井。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Mars entered Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Mars entered Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，镇星犯舆鬼中南星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jihai, Saturn offended the southern star among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth month Saturn trespassed on the southern star of the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，彗星芒长五尺，见天市中，东南指，色黄白，九月戊辰不见。

translations.literal: On yichou, a comet’s ray was five feet long, seen in the Celestial Market, pointing southeast, color yellow-white; on wuchen in the ninth month it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou a comet showed a five-foot coma in the Celestial Market, its train southeast, pale yellow-white; by wuchen in the ninth month it had vanished.

sentences.zh: 荧惑犯舆鬼为死丧，质星为戮臣，入太微为乱臣。

translations.literal: Mars offending the Ghosts means death and mourning; the “substance” star means ministers to be executed; entering the Grand Tenuity means rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mars on the Ghosts betokens death; the attendant star, ministerial executions; entry into the Grand Tenuity, treason at court.

sentences.zh: 镇星犯舆鬼为丧。

translations.literal: Saturn offending the Ghosts means mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn afflicting the Ghosts foretells mourning.

sentences.zh: 彗星见天市中为贵人。

translations.literal: A comet seen in the Celestial Market means eminent persons.
translations.idiomatic: A comet in the Celestial Market marks the fate of great nobles.

sentences.zh: 至和平元年二月甲寅，梁太后崩，梁冀益骄乱矣。

translations.literal: By the first year of Heping, in the second month, on the day jiayin, Empress Dowager Liang passed away; Liang Ji grew ever more arrogant and lawless.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Heping 1, on jiayin, Empress Dowager Liang died, and Liang Ji’s arrogance spun out of control.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年二月戊子，太白昼见。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanjia, in the second month, on the day wuzi, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the second month of Yuanjia 1, Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 永兴二年闰月丁酉，太白昼见。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxing, in the intercalary month, on the day dingyou, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the intercalary month of Yongxing 2, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 时，上幸后宫采女邓猛，明年，封猛兄演为南顿侯。

translations.literal: At that time the sovereign favored palace woman Deng Meng of the rear palaces; the next year he enfeoffed Meng’s elder brother Yan as marquis of Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then favored the selected attendant Deng Meng; the following year he made her brother Yan marquis of Nandun.

sentences.zh: 后四岁，梁皇后崩，梁冀被诛，猛立为皇后，恩宠甚盛。

translations.literal: After four years Empress Liang passed away, Liang Ji was executed, Meng was established as empress, and favor was exceedingly great.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later Empress Liang died, Liang Ji fell under the sword, Deng Meng was raised to empress, and imperial favor flooded her house.

sentences.zh: 永寿元年三月丙申，镇星逆行入太微中，七十四日去左掖门。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongshou, in the third month, on the day bingshen, Saturn retrograded into the Grand Tenuity; after seventy-four days it left the left side gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the third month of Yongshou 1 Saturn backed into the Grand Tenuity and only quit the left inner gate seventy-four days later.

sentences.zh: 七月己未，辰星入太微中，八十日去左掖门。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day jiwei, the Morning Star entered the Grand Tenuity; after eighty days it left the left side gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the seventh month Mercury entered the Grand Tenuity and emerged from the left gate eighty days later.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，荧惑入太微，二十一日出端门。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jisi, Mars entered the Grand Tenuity; twenty-one days later it emerged from the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the eighth month Mars crossed into the Grand Tenuity and left by the Duan Gate three weeks later.

sentences.zh: 太微，天子廷也。

translations.literal: The Grand Tenuity is the court of the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tenuity is the celestial counterpart of the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 镇星为贵臣妃后，逆行为匿谋。

translations.literal: Saturn is the eminent minister and empress; retrograde motion means hidden plotting.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn stands for chief ministers and the empress; backward motion hints at conspiracy.

sentences.zh: 辰星入太微为大水，一曰后宫有忧。

translations.literal: The Morning Star entering the Grand Tenuity means great flood; one opinion says the rear palaces will have worry.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury in the Grand Tenuity augurs inundation, or, in another reading, trouble in the harem.

sentences.zh: 是岁雒水溢至津门，南阳大水。

translations.literal: That year the Luo overflowed to the Jin Gate; Nanyang suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: The Luo that year rose to the Jin gate, and Nanyang was drowned in flood.

sentences.zh: 荧惑留入太微中，又为乱臣。

translations.literal: Mars lingering and entering the Grand Tenuity again means rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mars tarrying inside the Grand Tenuity again marked traitorous ministers.

sentences.zh: 是时梁氏专政。

translations.literal: At this time the Liang clan monopolized government.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang family then held the government in an iron grip.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，昼有流星长二尺所，色黄白。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiyou, by day there was a meteor about two feet long, color yellow-white.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the ninth month a yellow-white meteor two feet long flashed in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，荧惑犯岁星，为奸臣谋，大将戮。

translations.literal: On guisi, Mars offended Jupiter, meaning wicked ministers plotting, great general executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Mars crossed Jupiter, auguring cabals among favorites and the death of a commander.

sentences.zh: 二年六月甲寅，辰星入太微，遂伏不见。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the sixth month, on the day jiayin, the Morning Star entered the Grand Tenuity, then hid and was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the sixth month of Yongshou 2 Mercury entered the Grand Tenuity and vanished from sight.

sentences.zh: 辰星为水，为兵，为妃后。

translations.literal: The Morning Star is water, is troops, is consorts and empresses.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury governs floods, armies, and the women of the inner court.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，太白犯轩辕大星，为皇后。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuwu, Great White offended the great star of the Chariot Shaft, meaning the empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eighth month Venus trespassed Regulus, the star of the empress.

sentences.zh: 其三年四月戊寅，荧惑入东井口中，为大臣有诛者。

translations.literal: That third year, fourth month, day wuyin, Mars entered the mouth of Eastern Well, meaning great ministers will have one executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the fourth month of the third year Mars slipped into the mouth of Eastern Well, foretelling a minister’s execution.

sentences.zh: 其七月丁丑，太白犯心前星，为大臣。

translations.literal: That seventh month, day dingchou, Great White offended the forward star of Heart, meaning great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the seventh month Venus crossed the leading star of Heart, the omen of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 后二年七月，懿献皇后以忧死。

translations.literal: After two years, in the seventh month, Honored Empress Xian died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, in the seventh month, Honored Empress Xian wasted away and died.

sentences.zh: 大将军梁冀使太仓令秦宫刺杀议郎邴尊，又欲杀邓后母宣。

translations.literal: Great general Liang Ji ordered granary director Qin Gong to assassinate gentleman consultant Bing Zun, and also wished to kill Empress Deng’s mother Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ji the great general sent granary intendant Qin Gong to murder adviser Bing Zun and plotted the death of Lady Xuan, the empress dowager’s mother.

sentences.zh: 事觉，桓帝收冀及妻寿襄城君印绶，皆自杀。

translations.literal: When the affair was exposed, Emperor Huan seized the seals and ribbons of Ji and his wife Shou, lady of Xiangcheng; all killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot surfaced, Emperor Huan confiscated the credentials of Liang Ji and his wife Lady Shou of Xiangcheng, and the couple committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 诛诸梁及孙氏宗族，或徙边。

translations.literal: The various Liang and the Sun clan kindred were executed, or banished to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang kindred and the Sun affines were extirpated or exiled to the borders.

sentences.zh: 是其应也。

translations.literal: This was its correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: These were the earthly echoes of those signs.

sentences.zh: 延熹四年三月甲寅，荧惑犯舆鬼质星。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanxi, in the third month, on the day jiayin, Mars offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the third month of Yanxi 4, Mars crossed the attendant star of the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，客星在营室，稍顺行，生芒长五尺所，至心一度，转为彗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinyou, a guest star was in Encampment, gradually direct-moving, growing a ray about five feet long, to one degree of Heart, then turned into a comet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the fifth month a guest star stood in Encampment, crept forward, sprouted a five-foot tail toward Heart, then blossomed into a full comet.

sentences.zh: 荧惑犯舆鬼质星，大臣有戮死者。

translations.literal: Mars offending the “substance” star of the Ghosts means great ministers will have one executed by cutting.
translations.idiomatic: Mars on the Ghosts’ attendant star foretold a minister’s violent death.

sentences.zh: 五年十月，南郡太守李肃坐蛮夷贼攻盗郡县，取财物一亿以上，入府取铜虎符，肃背敌走，不救城郭；

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year, Nanyang governor Li Su, for barbarian bandits attacking and plundering commanderies and counties and seizing property over one hundred million cash, entering the office to take the bronze tiger tally, Su turning his back on the enemy and fleeing, not saving the city walls;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Yanxi 5 Nanyang governor Li Su was charged after tribal raiders sacked his jurisdiction, looted more than a hundred million in goods, and he fled into his yamen only to seize the bronze tiger tally and abandon the walls;

sentences.zh: 又临黎阳竭者燕乔坐赃，重泉令彭良杀无辜，皆弃市。

translations.literal: also express-runner Yan Qiao at Liyang for embezzlement, Magistrate of Zhongquan Peng Liang for killing innocents, all exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: while express-runner Yan Qiao at Liyang and Zhongquan magistrate Peng Liang were executed in the marketplace for graft and judicial murder.

sentences.zh: 京兆虎牙都尉宋谦坐赃，下狱死。

translations.literal: Commandant of Tiger Fangs at the capital Song Qian, for embezzlement, was cast in prison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Capital commandant Song Qian died in custody on corruption charges.

sentences.zh: 客星在营室至心作彗，为大丧。

translations.literal: A guest star in Encampment to Heart becoming a comet means great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star that swells from Encampment toward Heart into a comet spells a state funeral.

sentences.zh: 后四年，邓后以忧死。

translations.literal: After four years the Deng empress died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later Empress Deng died of a broken heart.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月丁亥，太白昼见。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the eleventh month, on the day dinghai, Great White was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eleventh month of Yanxi 6, Venus blazed in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是时，邓后家贵盛。

translations.literal: At this time the Deng empress’s family was noble and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The Deng clan then towered over the court.

sentences.zh: 七年七月戊辰，辰星犯岁星。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, in the seventh month, on the day wuchen, the Morning Star offended Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the seventh month of Yanxi 7 Mercury crossed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，荧惑犯舆鬼质星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, Mars offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eighth month Mars again struck the Ghosts’ attendant star.

sentences.zh: 庚申，岁星犯轩辕大星。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Jupiter offended the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Jupiter crossed Regulus.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，太白犯房北星。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the day bingchen, Great White offended the northern star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the tenth month Venus trespassed the northern star of Room.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，辰星犯太白。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Morning Star offended Great White.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Mercury crossed Venus.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，荧惑犯轩辕第二星。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yichou, Mars offended the second star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the twelfth month Mars crossed the second star of the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯岁星为兵。

translations.literal: The Morning Star offending Jupiter means troops.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury crossing Jupiter augurs war.

sentences.zh: 荧惑犯质星有戮臣。

translations.literal: Mars offending the “substance” star means there will be a minister to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Mars on the attendant star promises an executed minister.

sentences.zh: 岁星犯轩辕为女主忧。

translations.literal: Jupiter offending the Chariot Shaft means worry for the chief woman.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter afflicting Regulus foretells grief for the empress.

sentences.zh: 太白犯房北星为后宫。

translations.literal: Great White offending the northern star of Room means the rear palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Venus on the north star of Room points to the harem.

sentences.zh: 其八年二月，太仆南乡侯左胜以罪赐死，胜弟中常侍上蔡侯悺、北乡侯党皆自杀。

translations.literal: That eighth year’s second month, Grand Coachman Marquis of Nanxiang Zuo Sheng was ordered to death for a crime; Sheng’s younger brothers Regular Attendant Marquis of Shangcai Zuo Guan and Marquis of Beixiang Zuo Dang all committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year Grand Coachman Zuo Sheng, marquis of Nanxiang, was condemned to death; his brothers, eunuch Zuo Guan marquis of Shangcai and Zuo Dang marquis of Beixiang, killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，皇后邓氏坐执左道废，迁于桐宫死，宗亲侍中沘阳侯邓康、河南尹邓万、越骑校尉邓弼、虎贲中郎将安阳侯邓会、侍中监羽林左骑邓德、右骑邓寿、昆阳侯邓统、淯阳侯邓秉、议郎邓循皆系暴室，万、会死，康等免官。

translations.literal: On guihai, Empress Deng was deposed for practicing the left path, removed to the Tong Palace where she died; her kindred attendant-in-chamber Marquis of Biyang Deng Kang, governor of Henan Deng Wan, colonel of the swift cavalry Deng Bi, gentleman of the household for the tiger guard Marquis of Anyang Deng Hui, attendant-in-chamber director of the Feathered Forest left cavalry Deng De, right cavalry Deng Shou, Marquis of Kunyang Deng Tong, Marquis of Yuyang Deng Bing, gentleman consultant Deng Xun were all confined in the Blazing Room; Wan and Hui died, Kang and the rest were removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Empress Deng was cast down for illicit rites and died in the Tong Palace; her kinsmen Deng Kang, Deng Wan, Deng Bi, Deng Hui, Deng De, Deng Shou, Deng Tong, Deng Bing, and Deng Xun were locked in the Blazing Room—Wan and Hui perished, the others were stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 又荆州刺史芝、交阯刺史葛祗皆为贼所拘略，桂阳太守任胤背敌走，皆弃市，荧惑犯舆鬼质星之应也。

translations.literal: Also Jingzhou inspector Zhi and Jiaozhi inspector Ge Zhi were both seized and plundered by bandits; Guiyang governor Ren Yin turned his back on the enemy and fled; all were exposed in the market—the correspondence of Mars offending the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors of Jingzhou and Jiaozhi were captured by rebels, Guiyang’s Ren Yin fled before the enemy, and all were executed in the marketplace—the fulfillment of Mars on the Ghosts’ attendant star.

sentences.zh: 八年五月癸酉，太白犯舆鬼质星。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, in the fifth month, on the day guiyou, Great White offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fifth month of Yanxi 8 Venus crossed the Ghosts’ attendant star.

sentences.zh: 壬午，荧惑入太微右执法。

translations.literal: On renwu, Mars entered the Right Law Enforcer of the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Mars entered the Right Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 闰月己未，太白犯心前星。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, Great White offended the forward star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the intercalary month Venus crossed the leading star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，岁星犯左执法。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the day guiyou, Jupiter offended the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the tenth month Jupiter trespassed on the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，岁星入太微，犯左执法。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuwu, Jupiter entered the Grand Tenuity and offended the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eleventh month Jupiter crossed into the Grand Tenuity and brushed the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 九年正月壬辰，岁星入太微中，五十八日出端门。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, in the first month, on the day renchen, Jupiter entered the Grand Tenuity; fifty-eight days later it emerged from the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the first month of Yanxi 9 Jupiter entered the Grand Tenuity and left by the Duan Gate fifty-eight days later.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，太白行人舆鬼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renxu, Great White traveled among the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the sixth month Venus passed through the Ghosts.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，荧惑行舆鬼中，犯质星。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day yiwei, Mars traveled among the Ghosts, offending the “substance” star.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the seventh month Mars coursed through the Ghosts and struck the attendant star.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，荧惑入太微西门，积五十八日。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinhai, Mars entered the west gate of the Grand Tenuity, accumulating fifty-eight days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth month Mars slipped in the west gate of the Grand Tenuity and stayed fifty-eight days.

sentences.zh: 永康元年正月庚寅，荧惑逆行入太微东门，留太微中百一日出端门。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, in the first month, on the day gengyin, Mars retrograded into the east gate of the Grand Tenuity, lingered in the Grand Tenuity one hundred one days, then emerged from the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the first month of Yongkang 1 Mars backed through the east gate of the Grand Tenuity, tarried one hundred one days, and exited the Duan Gate.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，太白昼见经天。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day bingxu, Great White was seen by day crossing the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the seventh month Venus shone by day clear across the heavens.

sentences.zh: 太白犯心前星，太白犯舆鬼质星有戮臣。

translations.literal: Great White offending the forward star of Heart; Great White offending the “substance” star of the Ghosts means there will be a minister to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Venus on the forward star of Heart and on the Ghosts’ attendant star both augur ministerial executions.

sentences.zh: 荧惑入太微为贼臣。

translations.literal: Mars entering the Grand Tenuity means treacherous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mars inside the Grand Tenuity marks traitorous favorites.

sentences.zh: 太白犯心前星为兵丧。

translations.literal: Great White offending the forward star of Heart means troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Venus on the forward star of Heart betokens war and bereavement.

sentences.zh: 岁星入太微犯左执法，将相有诛者。

translations.literal: Jupiter entering the Grand Tenuity and offending the Left Law Enforcer means generals and ministers will have one executed.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter crossing the Left Law Enforcer in the Grand Tenuity foretells a minister’s death sentence.

sentences.zh: 岁星入守太微五十日，占为人主。

translations.literal: Jupiter entering and guarding the Grand Tenuity fifty days, omen reads: the human ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter’s fifty-day vigil in the Grand Tenuity was read as an omen bearing on the sovereign himself.

sentences.zh: 太白、荧惑入舆鬼，皆为死丧，又犯质星为戮臣。

translations.literal: Great White and Mars entering the Ghosts both mean death and mourning; again offending the “substance” star means ministers to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mars in the Ghosts alike mean death; striking the attendant star adds ministerial executions.

sentences.zh: 荧惑留太微中百一日，占为人主。

translations.literal: Mars lingering in the Grand Tenuity one hundred one days, omen reads: the human ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Mars’s hundred-one-day stay in the Grand Tenuity likewise touched the person of the ruler.

sentences.zh: 太白昼见经天为兵，忧在大人。

translations.literal: Great White seen by day crossing the sky means troops; worry is among great men.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus spanning the sky augured armies and dread among the mighty.

sentences.zh: 其九年十一月，太原太守刘□质、南阳太守成瑨皆坐杀无辜，荆州刺史李隗为贼所拘，尚书郎孟珰坐受金漏言，皆弃市。

translations.literal: That ninth year’s eleventh month, Taiyuan governor Liu Zhi, Nanyang governor Cheng Jin, both for killing innocents, Jingzhou inspector Li Wei seized by bandits, secretariat gentleman Meng Gang for accepting gold and leaking words, all exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year Taiyuan governor Liu Zhi and Nanyang governor Cheng Jin were executed for judicial murder, Jingzhou inspector Li Wei was taken by rebels, and secretariat gentleman Meng Gang for bribery and indiscretion—all died in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 永康元年十二月丁丑，桓帝崩，太傅陈蕃、大将军窦武、尚书令尹勋、黄门令山冰等皆枉死，太白犯心，荧惑留守太微之应也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, twelfth month, day dingchou, Emperor Huan passed away; Grand Tutor Chen Fan, great general Dou Wu, Director of the Secretariat Yin Xun, Yellow Gate director Shan Bing and others all died unjustly—the correspondence of Great White offending Heart and Mars lingering guarding the Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the twelfth month of Yongkang 1 Emperor Huan died; Chen Fan, Dou Wu, Yin Xun, Shan Bing, and others perished in the purge—the earthly price of Venus on Heart and Mars rooted in the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 灵二十

translations.literal: Ling: twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ling the Filial and Sagely: twenty entries.

sentences.zh: 熹平元年十月，荧惑入南斗中。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiping, in the tenth month, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Xiping 1 Mars entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「荧惑所守为兵乱。

translations.literal: Omens say: “Where Mars guards there will be troops and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: “Where Mars stations itself expect mutiny and arms.

sentences.zh: 」斗为吴，其十一月，会稽贼许昭聚众自称大将军，昭父生为越王，攻破郡县。

translations.literal: ” The Dipper is Wu; that eleventh month Kuaiji bandit Xu Zhao gathered a host and called himself great general; Zhao’s father Sheng declared himself king of Yue and stormed commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper marks Wu; that November Xu Zhao of Kuaiji raised an army as self-styled great general while his father Sheng proclaimed a Yue kingship and overran the countryside.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，有星出文昌，入紫宫，蛇行，有首尾无身，赤色，有光、召垣墙。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the fourth month, there was a star that emerged from Wenchang, entered the Purple Palace, serpent-crawling, having head and tail without body, red color, having light, summoning the enclosure walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year a star wriggled from Wenchang into the Purple Palace like a snake, head and tail visible but no clear body, red and luminous, brushing the enclosure stars.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，太白犯心前星。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Great White offended the forward star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eighth month Venus crossed the forward star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 辛未，白气如一匹练，冲北斗第四星。

translations.literal: On xinwei, white vapor like one bolt of silk struck the fourth star of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a white band like a bolt of silk lanced the Dipper’s fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「文昌为上将贵相。

translations.literal: Omens say: “Wenchang is the supreme general and eminent minister.
translations.idiomatic: The text says: “Wenchang is the field marshal and chief minister.

sentences.zh: 太白犯心前星，为大臣。

translations.literal: Great White offending the forward star of Heart means great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Venus on the forward star of Heart marks the fate of senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 」后六年，司徒刘郃为中常侍曹节所谮，下狱死。

translations.literal: ” After six years Minister of Education Liu He was slandered by Regular Attendant Cao Jie, cast in prison, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later Minister Liu He fell to Cao Jie’s calumnies and died in prison.

sentences.zh: 白气冲北斗为大战，明年冬，扬州刺史臧旻、丹阳太守陈寅，攻盗贼苴康，斩首数千级。

translations.literal: White vapor striking the Northern Dipper means great battle; the next winter Yangzhou inspector Zang Min and Danyang governor Chen Yin attacked bandit Ju Kang, beheading several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: A white band on the Dipper meant a great battle; the next winter Yangzhou inspector Zang Min and Danyang governor Chen Yin crushed the outlaw Ju Kang and took thousands of heads.

sentences.zh: 光和元年四月癸丑，流星犯轩辕第二星，东北行入北斗魁中。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guanghe, in the fourth month, on the day guichou, a meteor offended the second star of the Chariot Shaft, traveling northeast into the bowl of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the fourth month of Guanghe 1 a meteor grazed the second star of the Chariot Shaft and streaked northeast into the Dipper’s bowl.

sentences.zh: 八月，彗星出亢北，入天市中，长数尺，稍长至五六丈，赤色，经历十余宿，八十余日，乃消于天菀中。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, a comet emerged north of Kang, entered the Celestial Market, several feet long, gradually lengthening to five or six rods, red color, passing more than ten lodges, eighty-odd days, then dissipated in the Celestial Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a comet rose north of Kang, swept into the Celestial Market, grew from a few feet to five or six zhang of crimson fire, crossed a dozen constellations over eighty days, and faded in the Celestial Park.

sentences.zh: 流星为贵使，轩辕为内宫，北斗魁主杀。

translations.literal: A meteor is a noble envoy; the Chariot Shaft is the inner palace; the bowl of the Northern Dipper governs killing.
translations.idiomatic: Meteors are imperial couriers; Regulus is the inner court; the Dipper’s bowl is execution.

sentences.zh: 流星从轩辕出抵北斗魁，是天子大使将出，有伐杀也。

translations.literal: A meteor emerging from the Chariot Shaft and reaching the bowl of the Northern Dipper means a great envoy of the Son of Heaven will go out, there will be punitive killing.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor from Regulus to the Dipper’s bowl meant Heaven was dispatching a great punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 至中平元年，黄巾贼起，上遣中郎将皇甫嵩、朱俊等征之，斩首十万余级。

translations.literal: By the first year of Zhongping, the Yellow Turban bandits rose; the sovereign sent generals of the household Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, and others to campaign against them, beheading over one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongping 1 the Yellow Turbans erupted; the court sent Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun, and other generals of the household and took more than a hundred thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 彗除天市，天帝将徙，帝将易都。

translations.literal: A comet sweeping the Celestial Market means the August Thearch will move, the emperor will change capital.
translations.idiomatic: A comet clearing the Celestial Market augured removal of the capital and a new seat for the throne.

sentences.zh: 至初平元年，献帝迁都长安。

translations.literal: By the first year of Chuping, Emperor Xian moved the capital to Chang’an.
translations.idiomatic: In Chuping 1 Emperor Xian transferred the court to Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，彗星出狼、弧，东行至于张乃去。

translations.literal: In the third year, in winter, a comet emerged from Wolf and Bow, traveled east to Extended Net, then departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year a comet rose between Wolf and the Bow, tracked east as far as Extended Net, and faded away.

sentences.zh: 张为周地，彗星犯之为兵乱。

translations.literal: Extended Net is Zhou territory; a comet offending it means troops and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net marks the old Zhou heartland; a comet there augured war and upheaval.

sentences.zh: 后四年，京都大发兵击黄巾贼。

translations.literal: Four years later the capital dispatched a great army to strike the Yellow Turban bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later the court mobilized a massive host against the Yellow Turbans.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，荧惑在太微中，守屏。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in the fourth month, Mars was in the Grand Tenuity, guarding the screen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year’s fourth month Mars stood in the Grand Tenuity, posted at the screen stars.

sentences.zh: 七月，彗星出三台下，东行入太微，至太子、幸臣，二十余日而消。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, a comet emerged below the Three Steps, entered east into the Grand Tenuity, reaching Heir Apparent and favored ministers, twenty-odd days then dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month a comet rose beneath the Three Steps, slid east into the Grand Tenuity toward the Heir Apparent and favorite stars, and died out after some twenty days.

sentences.zh: 十月，岁星、荧惑、太白三合于虚，相去各五六寸，如连珠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Jupiter, Mars, and Great White formed a triple conjunction in Emptiness, each separated five or six inches, like linked pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Jupiter, Mars, and Venus converged on Emptiness within a handspan, strung like pearls on a thread.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「荧惑在太微为乱臣。

translations.literal: Omens say: “Mars in the Grand Tenuity means rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: “Mars in the Grand Tenuity marks treacherous ministers at court.

sentences.zh: 」是时，中常侍赵忠、张让、郭胜、孙璋等，并为奸乱。

translations.literal: ” At this time Regular Attendants Zhao Zhong, Zhang Rang, Guo Sheng, Sun Zhang, and others together wrought wicked disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile eunuchs Zhao Zhong, Zhang Rang, Guo Sheng, Sun Zhang, and their clique ran riot through the government.

sentences.zh: 彗星入太微，天下易主。

translations.literal: A comet entering the Grand Tenuity means the realm will change ruler.
translations.idiomatic: A comet in the Grand Tenuity foretold a change of sovereign.

sentences.zh: 至中平六年，宫车晏驾。

translations.literal: By the sixth year of Zhongping, the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongping 6 the emperor died, the euphemism for the sovereign’s passing.

sentences.zh: 岁星、荧惑、太白三合于虚为丧。

translations.literal: Jupiter, Mars, and Great White triple conjunction in Emptiness means mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The triple conjunction on Emptiness spelled deep mourning for the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 虚，齐地。

translations.literal: Emptiness is Qi territory.
translations.idiomatic: Emptiness corresponds to the old Qi domain.

sentences.zh: 明年，琅邪王据薨。

translations.literal: The next year the king of Langye Ju passed away.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Liu Ju, king of Langye, died.

sentences.zh: 光和中，国皇星东南角去地一二丈，如炬火状，十余日不见。

translations.literal: In the Guanghe period, the “state-yellow” star at the southeast corner one or two rods from the ground was like torch fire; ten-odd days it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: During Guanghe a “state-yellow” fireball hung a zhang or two above the southeastern horizon like a beacon, then vanished after a dozen days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「国皇星为内乱，外内有兵丧。

translations.literal: Omens say: “The state-yellow star means inner turmoil; without and within there will be troops and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication says: “That star signals civil strife and slaughter inside and outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 」其后黄巾贼张角烧州郡，朝廷遣将讨平，斩首十余万级。

translations.literal: ” Later the Yellow Turban Zhang Jiao burned commanderies and counties; the court sent generals to pacify them, beheading over one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiao’s rebels then torched the provinces until imperial generals crushed them and took more than a hundred thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 中平六年，官车晏驾，大将军何进令司隶校尉袁绍私募兵千余人，阴跱雒阳城外，窃呼并州牧董卓使将兵至京都，共诛中官，对战南、北宫阙下，死者数千人，燔烧宫室，迁都西京。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhongping, the imperial carriage halted at dusk; great general He Jin ordered Colonel Director of Retainers Yuan Shao secretly to recruit over a thousand soldiers, secretly station them outside Luoyang, secretly summon Bingzhou shepherd Dong Zhuo to lead troops to the capital, jointly execute the palace attendants; they battled below the south and north palace towers, several thousand dead, burned palace halls, moved the capital to the western capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongping 6 the emperor died; He Jin ordered Yuan Shao as colonel director of retainers to raise a thousand picked troops outside Luoyang and secretly call Dong Zhuo from Bingzhou; the plot to slaughter the eunuchs ignited fighting at the palace gates, thousands fell, the halls went up in flames, and the court fled west.

sentences.zh: 及司徒王允与将军吕布诛卓，卓部曲将郭汜、李傕旋兵攻长安，公卿百官吏民战死者且万人。

translations.literal: When Minister of Education Wang Yun with general Lü Bu executed Zhuo, Zhuo’s commanders Guo Si and Li Jue turned their troops to attack Chang’an; ministers of state, hundred officials, clerks, and commoners who died in battle were nearly ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: After Wang Yun and Lü Bu killed Dong Zhuo, Guo Si and Li Jue wheeled their hosts on Chang’an; nearly ten thousand officials and townspeople perished in the sack.

sentences.zh: 天下之乱，皆自内发。

translations.literal: The disorder of the realm all issued from within.
translations.idiomatic: The empire’s ruin had begun inside the palace, not on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 中平二年十月癸亥，客星出南门中，大如半筵，五色喜怒稍小，至后年六月消。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongping, in the tenth month, on the day guihai, a guest star emerged in the middle of the south gate, as large as half a mat, five colors of joy and anger gradually smaller, until the sixth month of the following year it dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the tenth month of Zhongping 2 a guest star the size of half a banquet mat rose in the south gate asterism, flashed through five shifting hues, shrank away, and was gone by the sixth month of the next year.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「为兵。

translations.literal: Omens say: “It means troops.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss says: “It betokens war.

sentences.zh: 」至六年，司隶校尉袁绍诛灭中官，大将军部曲将吴匡攻杀车骑将军何苗，死者数千人。

translations.literal: ” By the sixth year, Colonel Director of Retainers Yuan Shao exterminated the palace attendants; great general He Jin’s commander Wu Kuang attacked and killed chariots-and-cavalry general He Miao; several thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: By Zhongping 6 Yuan Shao had extirpated the eunuchs, while Wu Kuang, an officer of He Jin’s guard, cut down He Miao the chariot-and-cavalry general—several thousand died in the melee.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，荧惑逆行守心后星，十月戊午，月食心后星。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the fourth month, Mars retrograded and guarded the rear star of Heart; in the tenth month, on the day wuwu, the moon eclipsed the rear star of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year Mars retrograded onto the rear star of Heart; on wuwu in the tenth month the moon swallowed that same star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「为大丧。

translations.literal: Omens say: “It means great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The reading is: “It foretells a supreme bereavement.

sentences.zh: 」后三年而灵帝崩。

translations.literal: ” After three years Emperor Ling passed away.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Emperor Ling died.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，彗星出奎，逆行入紫宫，后三出，六十余日乃消。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, in the second month, a comet emerged from Kui, retrograded into the Purple Palace, later thrice emerged, over sixty days then dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year a comet lifted from Legs, backed into the Purple Palace, reappeared three times, and took more than sixty days to fade.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，客星如三升碗，出贯索，西南行入天市，至尾而消。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, a guest star like a three-sheng bowl emerged from Coiled Bonds, traveled southwest into the Celestial Market, dissipated at Tail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the sixth month a bowl-sized guest star rose at Coiled Bonds, drifted southwest through the Celestial Market, and died out at Tail.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「彗除紫宫，天下易主。

translations.literal: Omens say: “A comet sweeping the Purple Palace means the realm will change ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The text says: “A comet clearing the Purple Palace means the throne will change hands.

sentences.zh: 客星入天市，为贵人丧。

translations.literal: A guest star entering the Celestial Market means mourning for the noble.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star in the Celestial Market augured the death of a great noble.

sentences.zh: 」明年四月，宫车晏驾。

translations.literal: ” The next fourth month, the imperial carriage halted at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: The next fourth month the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 中平中夏，流星赤如火，长三丈，起河鼓，入天市，抵触宦者星，色白，长二三丈，后尾再屈，食顷乃灭，状似枉矢。

translations.literal: In midsummer of Zhongping, a meteor red as fire, three rods long, rose from River Drum, entered the Celestial Market, struck the Eunuch star, color white, two or three rods long, its tail twice bent, about a meal-time then extinguished, shaped like the Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: One Zhongping summer a three-zhang meteor red as flame shot from River Drum into the Celestial Market, clipped the Eunuch star in pale fire, kinked its tail twice, and burned out in the time it takes to eat a meal—like the Crooked Arrow omen.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「枉矢流发，其宫射，所谓矢当直而枉者，操矢者邪枉人也。

translations.literal: Omens say: “When the Crooked Arrow flows forth, its palace is shot; what is called an arrow that should be straight yet is crooked means the archer is a crooked evil man.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss says: “A Crooked Arrow meteor strikes the palace it names; a shaft that flies awry marks a twisted hand behind the bow.

sentences.zh: 」中平六年，大将军何进谋尽诛中官，中官觉，于省中杀进：俱两破灭，天下由此遂大坏乱。

translations.literal: ” In the sixth year of Zhongping, great general He Jin plotted to exterminate the palace attendants entirely; the attendants perceived it and in the palace killed Jin: both sides perished together, and from this the realm fell into great ruin and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongping 6 He Jin plotted the extermination of the eunuchs; they struck first and murdered him in the privy chamber—both factions annihilated each other and the empire slid into chaos.

sentences.zh: 六年八月丙寅，太白犯心前星，戊辰犯心中大星。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Great White offended the forward star of Heart; on wuchen it offended the great star in the middle of Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eighth month of Zhongping 6 Venus crossed the forward star of Heart; on wuchen it struck the central star of Heart.

sentences.zh: 其日未冥四刻，大将军何进于省中为诸黄门所杀。

translations.literal: That day, not yet dark four ke before nightfall, great general He Jin in the palace was killed by the various Yellow Gates.
translations.idiomatic: That same afternoon, four ke before dusk, the eunuchs cut down great general He Jin inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，车骑将军何苗为进部曲将吴匡所杀。

translations.literal: On jisi, chariots-and-cavalry general He Miao was killed by He Jin’s commander Wu Kuang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi chariot-and-cavalry general He Miao fell to Wu Kuang, an officer of He Jin’s guard.

sentences.zh: 孝献初平二年九月，蚩尤旗见，长十余丈，色白，出角、亢之南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chuping of Emperor Xian the Filial, in the ninth month, the Chiyou banner appeared, over ten rods long, white color, emerging south of Horn and Kang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Chuping 2 the Chiyou war-banner stretched ten zhang of white vapor south of Horn and Kang.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「蚩尤旗见，则王征伐四方。

translations.literal: Omens say: “When the Chiyou banner appears, the king campaigns against the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: The omen reads: “When the Chiyou banner rises, the ruler sends armies in every direction.

sentences.zh: 」其后丞相曹公征讨天下且三十年。

translations.literal: ” Later the Chancellor Cao campaigned against the realm nearly thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Chancellor Cao waged war across the empire for nearly three decades.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，孛星出两角间，东北行入天市中而灭。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in the tenth month, a broom star emerged between the two Horns, traveled northeast into the Celestial Market and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year a broom star rose between the Horns, ran northeast through the Celestial Market, and went out.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「彗除天市，天帝将徙，帝将易都。

translations.literal: Omens say: “A comet sweeping the Celestial Market means the August Thearch will move, the emperor will change capital.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss says: “A comet clearing the Celestial Market means Heaven’s ruler shifts his seat and the capital will move.

sentences.zh: 」是时上在长安，后二年东迁，明年七月，至雒阳，其八月，曹公迎上都许。

translations.literal: ” At this time the sovereign was at Chang’an; after two years he moved east; the next seventh month he reached Luoyang; that eighth month Lord Cao welcomed the sovereign up to Xu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was still at Chang’an; two years later he traveled east, reached Luoyang the following seventh month, and that eighth month Cao Cao escorted him to Xu.

sentences.zh: 建安五年十月辛亥，有星孛于大梁，冀州分也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jian’an, in the tenth month, on the day xinhai, there was a broom star in Great Beam, the division of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the tenth month of Jian’an 5 a broom star appeared in Great Beam, the celestial zone of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 时袁绍在冀州。

translations.literal: At that time Yuan Shao was in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shao then held Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 其年十一月，绍军为曹公所破。

translations.literal: That eleventh month, Shao’s army was broken by Lord Cao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cao Cao shattered Yuan Shao’s host.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，绍死，后曹公遂取冀州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year summer, Shao died; afterward Lord Cao took Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shao died the next summer, and Cao Cao soon seized Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，有星孛于东井舆鬼，入轩辕太微。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, in the eleventh month, there was a broom star in Eastern Well and the Ghosts, entering the Chariot Shaft and Grand Tenuity.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Jian’an 9 a broom star swept from Eastern Well and the Ghosts through Regulus into the Grand Tenuity.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，星孛于北斗，首在斗中，尾贯紫宫，及北辰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, in the first month, a broom star was in the Northern Dipper, head in the Dipper, tail piercing the Purple Palace and reaching the North Pole.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jian’an 11 a broom star straddled the Dipper, its coma in the bowl and its train lashing the Purple Palace toward the pole star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「彗星扫太微宫，人主易位。

translations.literal: Omens say: “A comet sweeping the Grand Tenuity palace means the human ruler will change position.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss reads: “A comet raking the Grand Tenuity means the Son of Heaven will be replaced.

sentences.zh: 」其后魏文帝受禅。

translations.literal: ” Later Wei Wendi received the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Wendi later accepted the Han abdication.

sentences.zh: 十二年十月辛卯，有星孛于鹑尾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the day xinmao, there was a broom star in the Quail’s Tail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the tenth month of Jian’an 12 a broom star rose in the Quail’s Tail.

sentences.zh: 荆州分也，时荆州牧刘表据荆州，益州从事周群以为荆州牧将死而失土。

translations.literal: It is the division of Jingzhou; at that time Jingzhou shepherd Liu Biao held Jingzhou; Yizhou clerk Zhou Qun thought the Jingzhou shepherd would die and lose the land.
translations.idiomatic: That sector maps Jingzhou, then held by Liu Biao; Zhou Qun of Yizhou read the sign as Biao’s death and the loss of his province.

sentences.zh: 明年秋，表卒，以小子琮自代。

translations.literal: The next autumn Biao died, his young son Cong replacing himself.
translations.idiomatic: The following autumn Liu Biao died, leaving his young son Cong as heir.

sentences.zh: 曹公将伐荆州，琮惧，举军诣公降。

translations.literal: Lord Cao was about to campaign against Jingzhou; Cong feared and led the whole army to surrender to the lord.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao Cao marched on Jingzhou, Liu Cong capitulated in fear with his entire army.

sentences.zh: 十七年十二月，有星孛于五诸侯。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, in the twelfth month, there was a broom star among the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Jian’an 17 a broom star appeared at the Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 周群以为西方专据土地者，皆将失土。

translations.literal: Zhou Qun thought those who monopolized territory in the west would all lose land.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Qun took it to mean every western warlord who clutched territory would lose it.

sentences.zh: 是时益州牧刘璋据益州，汉中太守张鲁别据汉中，韩遂据凉州，宗建别据枹罕。

translations.literal: At this time Yizhou shepherd Liu Zhang held Yizhou, Hanzhong governor Zhang Lu separately held Hanzhong, Han Sui held Liangzhou, Zong Jian separately held Fuhan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhang still ruled Yizhou, Zhang Lu held Hanzhong apart, Han Sui dominated Liangzhou, and Zong Jian gripped Fuhan.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，曹公遣偏将击凉州。

translations.literal: The next winter Lord Cao sent a deputy general to strike Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter Cao Cao dispatched a column against Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十九年，获宗建，韩遂逃于羌中，病死。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Zong Jian was captured; Han Sui fled among the Qiang and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In Jian’an 19 Zong Jian was taken; Han Sui fled among the Qiang and died sick.

sentences.zh: 其年秋，璋失益州。

translations.literal: That autumn Zhang lost Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Liu Zhang lost Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年秋，曹公攻汉中，鲁降。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year autumn, Lord Cao attacked Hanzhong; Lu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jian’an 20 Cao Cao invaded Hanzhong and Zhang Lu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十八年秋，岁星、镇星、荧惑俱入太微，逆行留守帝坐百余日。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year autumn, Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars all entered the Grand Tenuity, retrograded, stayed, and guarded the Imperial Seat over one hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jian’an 18 Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars piled into the Grand Tenuity, turned retrograde, and lingered on the Imperial Seat for more than a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「岁星入太微，人主改。」

translations.literal: Omens say: "Jupiter entering the Grand Tenuity means the human ruler will change."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication says: "Jupiter in the Grand Tenuity means the sovereign will be replaced."

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月，孛星晨见东方二十余日，夕出西方，犯历五车、东井、五诸侯、文昌、轩辕、后妃、太微，锋炎指帝坐。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, in the third month, a broom star at dawn was seen in the east over twenty days, at evening emerged in the west, offending and passing Five Chariots, Eastern Well, Five Feudal Lords, Wenchang, Chariot Shaft, rear consorts, Grand Tenuity, its blaze pointing at the Imperial Seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Jian’an 23 a broom star showed at dawn in the east for three weeks, reappeared at dusk in the west, and carved a path through Five Chariots, Eastern Well, the Five Lords, Wenchang, Regulus, the consort stars, and the Grand Tenuity, its spear aimed at the Imperial Seat.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「除旧布新之象也。」

translations.literal: Omens say: "It is the image of casting off the old and spreading the new."
translations.idiomatic: The gloss calls it "an omen of sweeping away the old and raising a new order."

sentences.zh: 桓帝延熹七年三月癸亥，陨石右扶风一，鄠又陨石二，皆有声如雷。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yanxi of Emperor Huan, in the third month, on the day guihai, a meteorite fell in Youfufeng on the right, one; at Hu again two meteorites, all had sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the third month of Yanxi 7 of Emperor Huan a meteorite struck Youfufeng, and two more fell at Hu, each thundering like a peal from Heaven.
